_readme: MIRC 2026 knowledge base — the ONLY thing the chatbot knows about the congress.
· null  = not yet supplied. The bot will say the detail is not published yet and
point the asker at the organisers. It will NEVER invent a value.
· []    = an empty list, treated the same way.
· Anything you write here, the bot will state as fact. Only put in what is confirmed.
· Add every remaining unknown to the "gaps" array so the bot can name what is missing.
That merges this file with the map's own food / sights / hotels / landmark data
into data/chat-corpus.json, which is what the chatbot actually reads.
Set meta.contentFrozen to true once the committee has signed the content off.
gaps: The full name MIRC stands for, and which edition this is
Congress dates and daily start/end times
The official website or registration page
The full programme: sessions, times, rooms, tracks, session chairs
Paper and poster titles, authors and abstracts
Keynote and plenary speakers, with bios
Registration fees, deadlines and how to register
On-site registration desk location and opening hours
Emergency contacts and the code of conduct
Confirmation of the room codes AVR, KL, BTB and TOP (see venue.buildings)

inScope: The MIRC 2026 programme, sessions, papers, posters and speakers
Session times, rooms and buildings on the PLM campus
Registration, fees, deadlines and the on-site desk
Congress logistics: meals, breaks, Wi-Fi, certificates, contacts, code of conduct
The venue and how to reach it, including walking directions
Getting around Intramuros as a delegate: places to eat, heritage sights, places to stay
outOfScope: Homework, assignments, maths problems and general study help
General knowledge, current affairs, news and trivia
Drafting essays, emails, posts or any other writing task
Translation, summarising or rewriting text the user supplies
Personal, medical, legal or financial advice
Anything about Manila beyond Intramuros, or travel unrelated to the congress
scope.decline: I can only help with MIRC 2026 and getting around Intramuros. Ask me about the programme, a session, the venue, registration, or where to eat nearby.
scope.unknown: That is not in the congress material I have. The organisers at the registration desk will be able to tell you.
suggestions: How do I get to PLM from the LRT?
Where can I eat near the venue?
What is there to see in Intramuros?

venue.name: Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM)
venue.alsoKnownAs: University of the City of Manila
venue.description: A full campus of colleges, gymnasiums and the PLM Chapel behind its own gate, in the southern quarter of the walled city. Sessions run in several buildings across the campus.

buildings.name: Justo Albert Auditorium
buildings.notes: A single auditorium venue, not a multi-room building.

buildings.name: Gusaling Katipunan (Katipunan Building)
buildings.notes: Coordinate from a visitor-supplied Google Maps pin; not independently verified.

buildings.name: Gusaling Emilio Ejercito Sr. (Emilio Ejercito Sr. Building)
buildings.notes: A visitor confirmed both the AVR and KL rooms are in this one building.

buildings.name: Gusaling Don Pepe Atienza (Don Pepe Atienza Building)
buildings.notes: On the Muralla Street side; home of the College / Mass Communication Office.
